articles.title: Mumbai Crime Branch Arrests Man and Seizes Hashish Worth Rs 1.5 Crore
articles.summary: Mumbai police arrested a forty-year-old man in Bandra West after seizing 1.505 kg of hashish valued at Rs 1.5 crore in the international market. Officers acted on credible information to raid a residence and registered a case under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act. Investigators suspect the accused was selling narcotics from his home.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi set to address Sangrur rally on Nov 4
articles.summary: Congress functionary Rahul Gandhi will visit Sangrur on Nov 4 to sound the party’s poll bugle in Punjab, state Congress president Pargat Singh said on Sunday, as AICC general secretary (organisation) K C Venugopal arrived in Chandigarh to oversee preparations for the visit and the party’s electoral strategy ahead of the 2027 assembly elections.

articles.title: As Cyclone Arnab nears, Odisha govt braces for its impact
articles.summary: With Cyclone Arnab likely to spare Odisha a direct hit but trigger heavy to extremely heavy rainfall across its southern districts, the state govt on Sunday intensified preparedness measures, deputing five senior IAS officers, deploying rescue teams and considering a pre-emptive release of water from Hirakud reservoir amid fears of heavy inflow into the Mahanadi system after landfall.

articles.title: Nagpur Police Hunt Tenant After Seizing Fake Currency Worth Lakhs
articles.summary: Police in Nagpur are searching for an absconding tenant following the seizure of fake currency worth eighty-five lakh rupees. Officers recovered counterfeit five hundred rupee notes, partially printed sheets, and a printer during the operation. Authorities aim to dismantle the counterfeiting operation and locate the suspect to prevent further illegal circulation of money in the region.

articles.title: Agrasar Bharat puts technology, execution and growth in focus
articles.summary: India’s development ambitions will depend on how effectively the country connects technology, infrastructure, investment, and institutional capability. That was the central theme at the inaugural Agrasar Bharat Manch, where government and industry leaders discussed the practical work required to translate the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision into economic and social outcomes.

articles.title: Karan Wahi breaks silence on breakup with Uditi, says marriage talk was misconstrued
articles.summary: Television actor Karan Wahi has clarified that while he entered his relationship with Uditi Singh hoping it would eventually lead to marriage, the couple never made concrete wedding plans. The 40-year-old, who dated the Bigg Boss 20 contestant for over two years, said they ultimately weren't compatible enough to make the relationship work.

articles.title: UNESCO adds three Indian sites to Tentative List, from Andaman volcanoes to Chhattisgarh’s
articles.summary: UNESCO has added three Indian properties to its World Heritage Tentative List: the Karst-mud-volcano Complex of Baratang, the Andaman Subduction Volcanoes and the Sirpur Cultural and Archaeological Landscape. Located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chhattisgarh, the sites represent Indias geological diversity and archaeological heritage. Tentative-list inclusion is a preliminary step, not final World Heritage recognition.

articles.title: UNESCO Adds Three New Indian Sites to Tentative List, Highlighting Chhattisgarh Temples
articles.summary: Inclusion on the Tentative List serves as a mandatory prerequisite for any property before a country can formally nominate it for full UNESCO World Heritage status. ​While placement on the Tentative List underscores the global geological and cultural value of these locations, it represents an initial nomination step and does not guarantee automatic World Heritage inscription.

articles.title: NRC logjam delays SIR in Assam, no clarity on timeline
articles.summary: Instead of SIR, a Special Revision (SR) was conducted. Illegal immigration from Bangladesh has long been a contentious issue in the state. articles.title: Congress leader Kumari Selja criticizes Haryana government over rising crime
articles.summary: On Sunday, Member of Parliament Kumari Selja criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party-led government in Haryana over a sharp increase in digital fraud, crime, drug addiction, and unemployment. articles.title: Lula vs Flavio Bolsonaro: 5 key issues shaping Brazil’s neck-and-neck election

articles.title: Man Arrested in Maharashtra for Assaulting Seven-Year-Old Girl
articles.summary: Police in the Thane district of Maharashtra arrested a thirty-five-year-old man for allegedly assaulting a seven-year-old girl on August twenty-fourth. The injured girl received hospital treatment while legal proceedings continue.

articles.title: Bihu troupe attacked in Assam's Sribhumi over Assamese songs; CM orders action
articles.summary: During a Durga Puja event in Sribhumi district, a Bihu troupe faced an attack from a group of individuals. articles.title: Delhi Steps Up NCR Coordination to Curb Winter Pollution

articles.title: 95 drug samples manufactured in HP fail quality tests
articles.summary: Across the country, 331 drug samples were found to be substandard, with Uttarakhand reporting 69 failures, followed by Maharashtra with 23, Madhya Pradesh with 22 and Haryana with 21. articles.title: Eminent Indian Painter And Former Politician Jogen Chowdhury Dies At 87
articles.summary: Renowned painter and former parliamentarian Jogen Chowdhury passed away on Sunday at the age of 87 after battling a rare blood cancer. articles.title: Oath-Taking Ceremony of New Jammu Kashmir Ministers Likely on Tuesday

articles.title: Over 100 Detained in Delhi as Protesters Demand Chief Election Commissioner Resign

articles.title: Bangladesh Government Ensures Safe Hindu Festival Amid Tight Security
articles.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman deployed thousands of security personnel across Bangladesh to safeguard the annual Hindu festival of Durga Puja. Authorities extended official holidays and increased financial assistance to committees, ensuring celebrations remained peaceful. This heavy deployment aimed to protect the minority community following years of anxiety and past violence, though community leaders continue demanding long-term justice.

articles.title_hinglish: pakistana aura kashmira para tippani ko lekara pharuka abdulla ki aalochana
articles.summary_hinglish: jammu-kashmira ke purva mukhyamantri pharuka abdulla ko usa tippani ke lie aalochana ka samana karana padaा, jisamen unhonne kaha tha ki pakistana isa kshetra ki anasulajhi sthiti ko antararashtriya stara para barakarara rakhane men madada kara raha hai। aalochakon ne tarka diya ki unaki tippaniyon ne sthaniya hiton ko kamajora kiya aura aatankavada ko prayojita karane ke pakistana ke itihasa ko najaraandaja kara diya। yaha tippani sanbhavita rupa se kendra shasita pradesha ko rajya ka darja bahala karane ke prayason men badha utpanna kara sakati hai।

articles.title: Navi Mumbai airport adds nine domestic destinations to expand regional connectivity
articles.summary: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) has added nine domestic destinations to its network, connecting the Mumbai Metropolitan Region with markets across Rajasthan, Bihar, Assam, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Lakshadweep and coastal Maharashtra. articles.summary_hinglish: navi munbaee antarrashtriya havaee adde (NMIA) ne apane netavarka men nau gharelu gantavya jodaे hain, jo munbaee mahanagara kshetra ko rajasthan, bihar, asam, jharakhand, pashchima bangal, lakshadvipa aura tatiya maharashtra ke bajaron se jodate hain। vistara ka uddeshya kshetriya pahuncha men sudhara karan, paryatana ka samarthana karana aura virasat, vanya jivan, dvipa aura paryavarana-paryatana sthalon ke satha sanbandhon ko majabuta karana hai।

articles.title: Indian Railways Launches First Salt Container Train In Gujarat
articles.summary: Indian Railways has launched a specialised salt container train between Shivlakha Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal in Kutch and Mithapur, Gujarat. articles.title: We deeply apologise: Organisers break silence after Shilpa Rao's set is cut short
articles.summary: The organisers of the Bollywood Music Project (BMP) have apologised after singer Shilpa Rao’s performance at the festival’s 10th anniversary edition in Mumbai was abruptly cut short on October 24. Her microphone and electronic audio equipment were reportedly switched off mid-performance after the event ran behind schedule. The incident drew criticism from festival-goers and fans, and #JusticeForShilpaRao began trending online.

articles.title: MCA extends company filing deadlines for FY26; financial statements due by December 31
articles.summary: Under the revised schedule, companies can file financial statements through various versions of Form AOC-4, including consolidated financial statements, XBRL-format filings and applicable forms for non-banking financial companies, by December 31, 2026, without additional fees. The deadline for filing annual returns through Forms MGT-7 and MGT-7A has been extended to January 31, 2027, according to an MCA circular.

articles.title: Global Youth Protests Expose Deepening Economic Insecurity And Inequality
articles.summary: Young people across Asia and Europe are staging protests over high youth unemployment, stagnant incomes, and rising living costs. articles.title: Millions removed from Indian voter rolls sparking protests and bureaucratic hurdles
articles.summary: Millions of citizens were removed from electoral rolls during a government revision in India, mistakenly classified as dead or ineligible. articles.title: ‘Immense Pride and Joy’: PM Modi Hails India’s Record 114 Medals at Asian Para
articles.summary: India’s para-athletes finished the Asian Para Games 2026 with a record 114 medals, prompting Prime Minister Narendra Modi to hail an achievement he described as an occasion of “immense pride and joy” for the country. The contingent collected 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals at Aichi-Nagoya, surpassing India’s revised tally of 108 from the previous edition.
